chapter: Arriving in New York: the Nest Club and Harlem nightlife
title: Chicken Cock whiskey in a can
summary: Danny and Smitty bought canned Chicken Cock whiskey at the Mad House, which was thrown overboard from rum-runners' boats.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: But that was a wild street. Smitty and I used to come upstairs some mornings... We'd go in the Nest Club. When we'd have a break, then we'd come upstairs and go in the Mad House, and we would buy Chicken Cock Whiskey, which was whiskey that came in a can.
Yeah. You'd get a pint of whiskey, a regular pint bottle...

It came in a can. And it came in quart cans, too. Like an olive can, like an oblong, square, tall... Just like you'd pack whiskey, but with a can. Now, the reason for that was they used to make this Chicken Cock Whiskey in Canada, and when the rum-runners would chase the guys... Owney Madden and them people that used to run whiskey. They talk about it now, if you mention his name...

They made their money, the racketeers, running whiskey across the Hudson River or some bay up there which connected the United States with Canada. And when the Coast Guard would overtake them, they would have these cans, not in cases, but in a big old thing like a net. And they just would throw it overboard, and the whiskey wouldn't sink. And later on, while the Coast Guard was chasing that boat, this other boat comes behind it to pick up the whiskey. Because they wouldn't worry about the whiskey so much as to catch the guys who were pushing it. So that was the reason why the cans...
